body.message:
We are pleased to offer a rental rate of AED 5,000 for a 30-day stay.

Please note that a security deposit of AED 2,000 is required. This deposit is fully refundable upon check-out, provided there are no damages to the apartment. The refund will be processed within 7 working days following your departure.

Should you choose to make the rental payment via our secure payment link, please be advised that a 3.1% card processing fee will apply in addition to the rental amount. Alternatively, payment can be made via bank transfer.

Please let us know if you would like us to provide the payment details.
